design.name: 狸猫行商 (tabby cat travelling merchant)
design.role: 商人：所有商店 / 首领前补给营的摊主；Unity 资产 SK_Npc_Merchant，动作 Idle / Talk
design.brief: A plump, cheerful anthropomorphic TABBY CAT travelling merchant (狸花猫行商). Big round head with a broad friendly face, half-closed sly smiling eyes in warm amber, long white whiskers drawn as a few thick carved strands, rounded ears, brown-and-grey tabby fur with bold dark stripes and a cream muzzle and chest, a short ringed tail. Round little spectacles on his nose. A wide conical woven bamboo hat (斗笠) pushed back on his head with a red cord. A knee-length deep teal merchant robe with gold copper-coin pattern trim, sleeves rolled to the elbows, a mustard-yellow sash around a round belly, a dark brown canvas apron with big pockets, loose dark trousers and cloth shoes. A wooden abacus hangs from the sash on his left hip, a string of square-holed copper coins on the right hip. On his back a compact bamboo frame backpack (书笈) with a small roof, stacked with a few glazed jars, rolled scrolls and a little brass lantern glowing with warm gold spirit fire. Hands with a clearly separate thumb and four separate fingers.
design.weapon: one paw raised in a welcoming wave and the other holding up a glowing elixir gourd for sale
design.turnaround_lead: Neutral standing A-pose for rigging: arms held about 40 degrees away from the body with straight elbows, both hands open, flat and EMPTY (nothing held), legs straight and slightly apart, mouth closed, friendly calm expression
design.turnaround_pose: , the bamboo hat, spectacles, abacus, coin string and the bamboo frame backpack with its jars, scrolls and small glowing brass lantern worn as on the sheet, the short tail pointing down and slightly back, fully shown in the side views
design.turnaround_digits: each hand open with a separate thumb and four separate slightly spread fingers, both shoes complete.
